record.paper_title: Open Problems in Global Analysis. Structured Foliations and the Information Geometry
record.original_question: Given a complex system or Big Data object in applied information geometry, determine whether it admits a prescribed geometric structure or a prescribed topological structure.

evidence.quote: whether a given complex system (or given Big Data) admits a prescribed geometry structure or a prescribed topological structure

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a broad open programmatic problem in applied information geometry concerning when a complex system or large dataset admits prescribed geometric or topological structures. No specific resolution is reported; related work (e.g., topological data analysis, Hessian/Kähler information geometry by Amari, Nielsen, and Barbaresco) addresses parts of the problem but no general criterion is known.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in Global Analysis (zbMATH)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems including whether a given complex system or Big Data admits a prescribed geometric or topological structure.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as open in a list of open problems on structured foliations and information geometry.
